bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
cid=gace-createvdobot-videobot-poll-1
pg=deploy-postgres-1
test "$(docker inspect "$cid" --format '{{.State.Running}}')" = true || exit 61
test "$(docker inspect "$pg" --format '{{.State.Running}}')" = true || exit 62
sql="SELECT r.paid_message_id,r.listing_id,r.revision,r.topic_id,r.status,l.status,l.price_stars,l.rights_verified,l.adult_consent_verified,l.management_fee_bps,(l.fee_terms_accepted_at IS NOT NULL) AS fee_accepted, (l.paid_video_file_id IS NOT NULL) AS paid_file_ready, (l.sample_file_id IS NOT NULL AND l.thumbnail_file_id IS NOT NULL) AS previews_ready FROM videobot_post_receipts r JOIN videobot_listings l ON l.listing_id=r.listing_id WHERE r.paid_message_id IN (4691,4701) ORDER BY r.paid_message_id;"
docker exec -e "SQL=$sql" "$pg" sh -c 'psql -X -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -U "$POSTGRES_USER" -d videobot -At -F "|" -c "$SQL"'
docker exec "$cid" node --input-type=module -e 'console.log("LIVE_TOPIC_THREAD_ID="+process.env.VIDEOBOT_VIDEO_SALE_THREAD_ID);console.log("LIVE_TOPIC_TITLE_PRESENT="+Boolean(process.env.VIDEOBOT_VIDEO_SALE_TOPIC_TITLE));console.log("API_TARGET="+(process.env.VIDEOBOT_LOCAL_API_URL?"local":"official"));'
